# stb_image

`stb_image.h` is vendored from [nothings/stb](https://github.com/nothings/stb)
at commit `003501f6d7a8668ce8b6d875e34dd97ad0d5d5b5` (v2.30).
scrctl uses the MIT license option in `LICENSE` and enables only PNG decoding
from memory for its embedded window icon. No additional runtime library is needed.
